title: Happy Young Boy Holding Toy Boat in Garden, 1940s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A sunny outdoor snapshot of a young blonde boy smiling happily while holding a toy boat in a lush garden. He is dressed in a collared short-sleeved shirt and matching shorts, classic everyday playwear of the 1940s postwar era. Dense bushes and long leafy plants surround him, catching the harsh natural sunlight. The top front border features a handwritten caption in dark red ink reading 'Boat Crazy', while the reverse carries a solitary stamped number 72 in blue ink.
